The position of Treasury Management Coordinator provides assistance to the SVP/Treasury Operations Manager by performing various functions to provide a full range of technical and general support pertaining to Treasury Management services and their corresponding features. This position performs basic treasury activities, expense management activities, and accounting and reporting for related entities leveraging resources to maximize productivity and delivering high quality service. This position reports directly to the SVP/Treasury Operations Manager and works closely with internal teams and other stakeholders to complete requests. This individual adheres to policies and procedures related to treasury and expense activities, accounting, and reporting.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES
1.    Upholds, at all times, the Bank’s Core Values of: Integrity, Respect, Positive Attitude, Empowerment, Accountability, and Excellence.
2.    Delivers on the Bank’s tagline of “Your Best Banking Experience – Ever!” by reinforcing the application of superior customer service through own example along with appropriate follow through with involved customers and employees; actively participates in specific periodic meetings and presentations on this topic with all staff members.
3.    Provides assistance to sales team and clients when meeting with new and existing clients for online banking and Treasury Management Services and Products.

The Commercial Note Department Associate will be a highly motivated and resourceful member of the Commercial Note Department and will handle complex commercial and consumer loan documents ensuring completeness and accuracy in accordance with credit/bank policy and State/Federal Regulatory requirements. This role requires someone with strong follow-through skills who is adaptable and embraces change. Responsibilities include working closely with the Lending Team and attorneys to manage the loan closing process, boarding loans, monitoring and enforcing post-closing exception items, and controlling the disbursement of loan proceeds by ensuring adherence to loan approval requirements. May participate in special lending-related projects as directed by Senior Management.
